messages:
tess: PRD draft uploaded — quick sync please. I'm proposing we split the Observability Console work into an MVP focused on retention controls + auditability, and a Phase 2 focused on trace UX polish. Need agreement on acceptance criteria, non-destructive migration, and which customer asks we take into MVP. link: https://internal.redwood/prd/obs-retention-split

michelle (security): skimmed. split makes sense. one ask: retention changes must create audit records and be queryable by timestamp + actor. also confirm RBAC: only org-admins should change org-level defaults.

rahul (eng): high-level perf ask from infra: we need constraints for large orgs. propose acceptance: dashboard list & route view load < 800ms p95 for orgs with up to 1000 routes. otherwise we'll tank page load.

jordan (design): will hand off mocks for per-route retention flow and bulk modal by EOD Thu. two UX points: confirmation step for bulk changes, and inline tooltip explaining "what happens to old data". also need copy for the warning when retention decreases.

samir (support): several customers requested bulk-set for retention and an API to automate it. also enterprise wants a soft-rollback if they accidentally lower retention. we should add an explicit API + export before apply step to MVP acceptance.

deploy-bot: deployment: PRD -> rfc branch created by tess at /rfc/obs-retention-split (auto)

---

tess: proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
1) UI: Org admins can set per-route retention and save a new value. Setting shows a non-destructive notice.
2) API: Expose POST /api/v1/retention/bulk and GET /api/v1/retention to read & modify programmatically.
3) Audit: Every retention change creates an immutable audit entry with actor, timestamp, old/new values.
4) Migration: Lowering retention does NOT automatically delete data; data eligible for purge is flagged and only removed when a separate purge job is run (Phase 2 can automate).
5) Telemetry: Emit metric `retention.change` with org_id, actor_type, old/new buckets.
6) Perf: Route list and single-route page p95 <= 800ms for <=1000 routes.
7) Edgecases: Setting retention=0 should be invalid; min allowed 1 day; UI prevents accidental infinite retention.

rahul (eng): minor edits: change perf target to 500ms p95 for route list if we want snappy experience; otherwise agree. For Migration acceptance, add: "system must provide an export of data eligible for purge before purge job runs".

michelle (security): add acceptance: retention changes must surface in existing audit-logs backed by KMS-signed events (same provenance as other config changes). Also must be accessible to compliance exports (CSV/JSON) via admin console.

jordan (design): edgecases to call out in acceptance:
- tenant with zero routes: UI shows onboarding CTA (do not break).
- bulk set across >500 routes: show progress indicator and async job with notification.
- conflicts: concurrent edits should alert and show last-writer timestamp.

samir (support): customer ask captured -> add acceptance: provide "preview" step when applying bulk retention that shows estimated rows affected and allows export. Also document rollback path (export + apply previous).

tess: OK — here's a suggested scope split: MVP (next milestone): per-route set in UI, bulk API (basic), audit log entries, telemetry, non-destructive migration behavior, confirmation modals, and basic docs. Phase 2: automated purge pipeline (scheduled purge job with retention enforcement), advanced rollback tools, per-team defaults, and trace UX polish (span-level retention controls).

rahul (eng): thumbs up for scope split. NOTE: if we take automated purge in MVP it adds 4 weeks. prefer Phase 2.

michelle (security): :thumbsup: to MVP scope. Phase 2 for purge is fine.

jordan (design): :thumbsup: MVP + Phase 2 split works. I'll drop mocks for MVP flows only.

samir (support): :thumbsup: MVP covers most customer asks, we'll drive enterprise customers to adopt bulk API + export in docs.

tess: quick vote: MVP-only now? react with :thumbsup: to accept as-is, :thumbsdown: to demand purge in MVP, :rocket: if you want to scope-down further.

rahul (eng): :thumbsup:
jordan (design): :thumbsup:
michelle (security): :thumbsup:
samir (support): :thumbsup:

---

tess: action items (assigned):
- rahul: write perf test plan + define p95 SLOs (due Mon)
- jordan: upload MVP mocks + copy (due Thu)
- michelle: compliance export acceptance wording + KMS notes (due Tue)
- samir: draft customer-facing doc snippet for bulk workflow + rollback (due Wed)
- tess: update PRD with these acceptance edits and post RFC for final review (due Fri)

rahul (eng): ack, will add test harness for orgs with 1000 routes and synthetic tracing load.

deploy-bot: reminder: weekly roadmap sync Wed 10:00 — PRD reviews welcome

tess: thanks all — I'll update the PRD and ping again when RFC branch is ready for review.

samir (support): noted, will collect 2 customer quotes to include in PRD (they want bulk API).

jordan (design): one last UX nit: include empty-state copy for "no retention rules" and micro-copy for the audit log entry view.

michelle (security): I'll validate the export format against compliance checklist once you post wording.

end of thread"
